author: PBG 19999
text: Just too basic: I only use this app because I trade a lot and paying AMC on zerodha comes out to be lower overall per year than paying per trade on groww. But god, this app is so frustrating. The UI is not user friendly at all, and everything leads to a redirect to browser. Basic information isn’t displayed in orderly fashion, and basic features like history of cancelled orders are missing. If you have been using groww, using zerodha is like downgrading from an Audi to a kia. The QoL and the whole ecosystem is just worlds apart. The day groww implements an AmC option for frequent traders is the day I will dump zerodha. Even now I only use zerodha to book the trade, all the actual R&D is done on groww before hand and all my MF are on groww too. This company is so pretentious with all its “honest” marketing, maybe they need the same energy to actually listen to their customers and implement features instead of pandering to people on social media on pseudo morality.

author: Vishwa08
text:
Enhancements - way forward: Here is a high-level feature enhancement plan for the Zerodha app to match and surpass competitor platforms:

1. Advanced Charting and Analytics

-Full TradingView integration including all chart types and indicators

-On-chart trading and order modifications

-Save and sync chart setups across devices

2. Watchlist Improvements

-Increase number of watchlists and instruments per list

-Allow custom groups and drag-and-drop organization

-Import/export watchlists via Excel or CSV

-Show key metrics like LTP, % change, volume on watchlist overview

3. Order and Trade Management

-Reintroduce Bracket Orders and trailing stop losses

-Basket level stop loss and target orders

-Order slicing and market protection features

-More advanced order types on mobile app

4. User Experience and Customization

-Option for light and advanced trading modes customizable by user

-Auto-rotate support for all app screens

-Better responsiveness and stability of premium charts

-Alerts and notifications for important trade events

5. Integration and Portfolio Tools

-AI-driven insights and research integrated in the app

-Comprehensive portfolio analytics and performance tracking

-Mutual fund gifting, SIP automation, and transparent interest tracking

6. Account and Fund Management

-Separate user flows/app modules for trading capital and investment capital

-Collateral margin management and enhanced margin trading facility

-Alerts for upcoming fund transfers or orders needing funds

7. Other Utilities

-Backtesting and strategy simulation tools

-Export/import capabilities for holdings and watchlist data

-Quick switching between stock charts with saved annotations

This plan provides a roadmap to enhance the Zerodha app’s capabilities in line with market demands and competitor offerings, improving usability, features, and reliability. It can be submitted to Zerodha’s review or feedback section as a concise suggestion document for their next development cycles.
